author: @reshmaghadge7801
text:
GREAT! AND IT WAS A VERY INTERESTING PODCAST,
AND MOST IMPORTANTLY, MR. MARK BOWDEN MAINTAINED THE SAME ENERGY FROM BEGINNING TO END AND WELCOMED QUESTIONS WITH AN OPEN MIND. THAT WAS REALLY GREAT.

I ALSO FEEL THAT WHENEVER WE ARE GOING TO A SOCIAL GATHERING OR AN IMPORTANT MEETING WHERE WE ARE GOING TO DISCUSS SOMETHING VERY IMPORTANT, IT IS ALWAYS BETTER TO REMAIN NATURAL IN THAT SITUATION. BECAUSE IF YOU GO THERE WITH THE INTENTION OF IMPRESSING OTHERS, YOU MAY DEFINITELY LOSE FOCUS ON THE THING THAT IS ACTUALLY IMPORTANT, AND UNNECESSARY THINGS MAY COME FORWARD AND CAUSE THE SITUATION TO SLIP OUT OF YOUR HANDS. THEREFORE, WE SHOULD NOT LOSE SIGHT OF THE CENTRE. INSTEAD OF TRYING TO APPEAR SUPERIOR, JUST BE WHO YOU ARE, AND WITH TIME, WE NATURALLY BECOME SUPERIOR. BECAUSE WHEN WE GIVE IMPORTANCE TO WHAT IS NATURAL, IT AUTOMATICALLY CREATES AN IMPACT.

AS WE SAW AT THE END OF THE PODCAST, THE APPRECIATION MR. BOWDEN GAVE ITSELF SHOWS HOW MUCH NATURAL THINGS CAN CREATE AN IMPACT,

AND ONE MORE THING I WOULD LIKE TO MENTION IS THAT THE PODCAST SETUP LOOKS REALLY GREAT AND KEEPS THE FOCUS ON THE CONVERSATION,

THANK YOU FOR SUCH AN INTERESTING CONVERSATION.
